issue: Keys, calendar, value ranges and file links
justification: Keys are unique, DayOfWeek agrees with Date, codes are valid, no negative sales or customers, all links match.

decision: Read as text with codes 0, a, b, c
justification: Otherwise numeric 0 and text '0' are treated as different values.

decision: Keep as is; flag stores (has_history_gap, missing_history_days); later features must not cross the gap
justification: Every affected store misses exactly the same block, so the cause is not a data error we can repair; filling it would invent sales.

issue: A store missing a single day
justification: One missing day has no practical effect.
All closed days already have zero sales; predict 0 whenever Open = 0.

decision: Flag as suspect_zero_sales and exclude from training through use_for_training; rows are kept
justification: Scattered across many stores and months, none on state holidays, almost all with zero customers, so they look like recording errors; keeping the rows avoids creating date gaps.

decision: Keep; the Open column carries the information
justification: These are real closures (a few stores close for long stretches); the model predicts 0 when Open = 0.

decision: Set Open = 1 by rule (not a Sunday, not a state holiday) and flag Open_imputed
justification: All affected days are ordinary weekdays, and in train this store closes only on Sundays and state holidays.

decision: Fill with the median distance and flag CompetitionDistance_missing
justification: Only a handful of stores; the distance is a store attribute, so no sales information is used.
Invented dates would create false competition ages; most of these stores do have a known distance.

decision: Treat the date as unknown and flag CompetitionOpenYear_suspect
justification: One year looks like a placeholder (1900); neither can be verified.

issue: Competitor opens after the last training date
justification: Their effect falls in the forecast period, so it cannot be learned from training history (see Limitations).

decision: Code as not applicable (PromoInterval = None, since week and year = 0)
justification: Every missing value belongs to a store with Promo2 = 0, so nothing is unknown.

issue: Unusually high or low sales (store-by-weekday robust z-score beyond 5)
decision: Keep and flag with sales_outlier_flag; nothing capped or removed
justification: High flags cluster in Easter and pre-Christmas months, which fits genuine peaks; low flags are few and their cause cannot be shown.
It mostly removes promotion days and large stores, which are exactly what the model must learn.

decision: Join on Store (many-to-one); row counts unchanged
justification: Every store has exactly one row in store.csv.
